user.title: Add a LYWSD02 / LYWSD02MMC
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Xiaomi LYWSD02 or LYWSD02MMC thermo-hygrometer. This adds a device page with a "Sync now" button, a built-in daily schedule and diagnostic entities. The legacy lywsd02.set_time service keeps working on its own.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered LYWSD02 / LYWSD02MMC
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

error.invalid_mac: That doesn't look like a valid MAC address.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported LYWSD02 / LYWSD02MMC.
abort.encrypted_not_supported: This is a LYWSD02MMC using encrypted MiBeacon broadcasts, which needs a bindkey and is not supported yet.

init.title: LYWSD02 Sync options
init.description: The built-in schedule replaces a hand-written automation: with it enabled this clock is synchronised by the integration itself. Everything below applies to the next sync.

data.sync_on_start: Also sync shortly after Home Assistant starts
